summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) and entered into an equity distribution agreement to sell up to $1.25 billion of common stock at-the-market through J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, and Citigroup. The market-price offering has no fixed price per share or premium; proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. The filing is a routine capital-raising activity with no extraordinary corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural complexities are present beyond standard ATM mechanics.
